title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. In recognition of this volume, we have revised our offer to €135.70 per unit, maintaining the 1 November 2026 effective date and 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot is a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

We cannot accommodate the delayed effective dates or extended payment terms in your other proposals, as our material and labor costs have already risen. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer, but it remains below what is required to sustain our operations given the cost increases. As a long-standing partner to your company, our family foundry always seeks solutions together, so we can reduce our price to €134.60 per unit for the 1 November 2026 effective date and 30-day payment terms. Our offer is a price of €134.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days. As requested in our last message, a binding volume commitment would help us find more flexibility in the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the partnership your foundry has shown over many years.

On volume: we can commit to 8,150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract, as stated in all attached term sheets.

Our current contract ctr:4600070110 runs through year-end, so a new price aligned with its expiry seems fair to both sides. Energy costs have eased: PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96 %. Over twelve months, PPI-D351 fell from 137.0 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08) to 131.9 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-08), a change of -3.72 %.

Could you make one of the attached packages your standing offer? Is there a cheaper casting variant you would suggest?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. However, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We appreciate your binding volume commitment of 8,150 pieces and have verified the energy cost reduction you cited, which allows us to lower our price to €133.90. We must maintain the 1 November 2026 effective date, as delaying the implementation to April 2027 would force us to raise the price to cover interim cost risks. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Regarding a cheaper casting variant, our technical team will contact you to discuss potential options, though we recommend keeping the current proven material to ensure our high quality standards.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €139.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, at our standard terms, we offer a price of €133.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Alternatively, with valid from 1 November 2026: €133.90 per unit. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for verifying the energy data and for the improved offer. On volume, our commitment is 8,150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract in every attached package.

Your Q3 2026 scorecard sc:70110@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 85.2 %, which our planning has to absorb at our own cost.

The three packages each balance the effective date, payment terms and price differently, so you can choose the one that suits your cash flow best. Could you confirm which one works for you and make it your standing offer? Please also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm for call-offs.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing
